paragraphs: I ~~ The ascetic Vilmiki asked that best of sages and fore- I most of those conversant with words, ever engaged in austerities and Vaidika studies, N&rada saying, — “Who at present ( in this world is alike crowned with qualities, and endued with I prowess, knowing duty, and grateful, and truthful, and firm in vow, -who is qualified by virtue of his character, and who is ever studious of the welfare of all creatures ? Who is learned, hath studied society, and knoweth the art of pleasing his subjects ? And who alone is ever lovely to hehold ? Who hath subdued his heart, and controlled his anger, is endowed with personal grace, and devoid of malice ; and whom, enraged in battle, do even the gods, fear ?

Great is my curiosity to hear of such a person. Thou canst,0 Maharshi ,' * tell me of a man of this description.” Hearing Vllmiki's words, NSLrada, cognizant of the three worlds, said with alacrity, — “Do thou listen ! Rare as are the qualities mentioned by thee, I will, O sage, having duly considered, describe unto thee a person endued with them. | There is one sprung from the line of IkshwSku, known by the name of RSma. He is of subdued soul and exceeding prow- , * Lit, a great saint. The word, however, signifies one belonging to a parti - RlMlYANA. ess ; effulgent ; endowed with patience ; having senses under ! control ; intelligent; learned in morality ; eloquent ; crowr ed ( with grace ; the slayer of foes ; broad-shouldered ; possessed ] of mighty arms, a conch-shaped neck, fleshy jaws, and a | broad chest ; a powerful bowman ; the repressor of foes ; having plump shoulder-blades ; of arms reaching down unto ] his knees ; with a beautiful head,and a graceful forehead ; and j endowed with excellent might; having symmetrical limbs ; and I of a cool hue ; and possessed of prowess ; and having a welldeveloped chest ; with expansive eyes ; crowned with auspici- ' ousness and favourable marks; knowing duty ; firm in promise ; j aye engaged in the good of his subjects ; of accomplished renown ; furnished with knowledge ; pure in body and spirit ; , modest towards superiors ; versed in self-knowledge ; like ' unto Prajipati himself ; blest with prosperity ; protecting all ; the destroyer of enemies, and supporter of all living beings ; ! and the stay of order,practising all the duties of his class; and preserving those cleaving unto him ; versed in the profundities of the Vedas and the Vedlngas ; accomplished in archery ; gifted with a good memory ; ascertaining with rapidity the truth of things ; the darling of all ; unreproved ; of i unvanquished spirit ; discerning ; proficient in every branch of learning ; ever resorted to by the good even as the ocean is, by the rivers ; worthy of being honored ; having an equal regard for all ; and capable of filling the heart with , ever-new sensations.

Crowned with every grace ; he enhanceth the joys of Kau9aly& ; being like unto the sea in gravity, and unto the Himavat in patience. In prowess, he is like unto Vishnu, and boasteth of the personal attractions of the Moon. In anger he resembleth the fire raging at the dissolution of all ; and in forgiveness, he is like unto the Earth. In giving away, he is like unto (Kuvera) the Bestower of riches, and in truth, he is like another Dharma. “Desirous of doing that which would be acceptable to his subject, king Ua9aratha, from fulness of affection, wished to r BlLAKlNDAM. instal as his associate in the kingdom his beloved and meritorious eldest son, Rama, of infallible prowess, and endued with sterling virtues, and ever intent on the welfare of the people.

Beholding the provisions for the installation, that lady the king’s consort, Kaikeyi, who had previously been promised two boons, even asked for these, viz., the exile of Rama, and the installation of Bharata. Bound by the ties of duty in consequence of that promise of his, king Da^aratha banished his favorite son Rama. In pursuance of his father's promise, and with the view of compassing the pleasure of Kaikeyi, that heroic one, commanded by his sire, wended into the forest. And on the eve of his departure for the forest, that enhancer of Sumitra’s joy and favorite of his brother (Rama), his dear brother Lakshmana, endowed with humility, displaying brotherliness, followed him out of affection. And as Rohini followeth the moon, Raima’s beloved spouse, sprung in Janaka’s line — like unto an embodiment of Divine power — dear (unto Rama) as life itself, and engaged in acts of good, and furnished with every auspicious mark, and the best of wives, followed Rama.

Having been followed far by his father Dayaratha along with the citizens, Rama met with the virtuous and beloved king of the Nishadas ; and then in company with Guha, Lakshmana, and Sita, dismissed his charioteer on the banks of the Ganges at Sringaverapura. Then wending from one wood to another, and having crossed many broad rivers, they, in accordance with Bharadw&ja’s directions, arrived at the Chitrakuta ; and constructing a romantic abode, the three began to live there as they listed. And they spent their days in delight, even like gods and Gandharbhas. And when ' Rama had reached the Chitrakuta, king Da^aratha, distressed | on account of his son, went to heaven, bewailing the latter. | And when Da^aratha had ascended heaven, the mighty Bharata, although pressed by the Brahmanas headed by Vasistha, to rule the kingdom, did not wish for dominion.

And that . hero went after Rama into the forest, with the view of pro- RXMXY ANA. pitiating that worshipful one. And having come to the high- j souled R3ma, with truth for his prowess, he besought his [ brother, with every mark of respect. And Rlma said unto Bharata these words, — “Thou too, O thou conversant with duty, art king.” And the exceedingly generous, illustrious and mighty R&ma of a cheerful countenance did not wish for the kingdom, in consonance with his father’s injunction. And having made over unto Bharata, as his substitute on the throne, his own sandals, Bharata’s elder brother repeatedly forbade him. And then Bharata, finding his desire not obtained, touched Rama’s feet, and began to rule at NandigrSma, expecting the return of Rama.

And when the auspicious Bharata, firm in promise and of subdued sense, had gone away, Rama again perceiving there the influx of citizens and others, eagerly entered Dandaka. And having entered that mighty forest, the lotus-eyed Rama slew the Rakshasa, Viradha, and saw Sarabhanga, Suitikshna, Agastya and Agastya’ s brother. And he then, directed by Agastya, gladly possessed himself of Indra’s bow, the inexhaustible arrows, the scimitar, and the quiver. And while Rama was dwelling there with the rangers of woods, the sages came to him in a body for the destruction of the Asuras and Rakshasas. Thereupon in the presence of those ascetics like unto flaming fire, inhabiting the Dandaka forest, he promised to slay those Rakshasas in battle.

And it was while he was living there that, that dweller of Janasthana, the Rakshasi Surpanakha, capable of assuming any form at will, was disfigured. And it was while living there in the society of the inhabitants of Janasthana, that Rama slew in battle the Rakshasas Khara and j Tri^ira and Dushana, together with their followers, who all had been stirred up by the words of Surpanakha. And fourteen thousand Rakshasas were slain in that battle. And ] learning of the destruction of his relatives, Ravana wrought into frenzy by anger, sought the aid of a Rakshasa named ! Maricha. And although strongly dissuaded by Maricha, saying , “Thou ought not to enter into hostilities with that powerful one. Do thou, therefore, O RSvana, excuse me !”

Yet, disregarding those words of his, R&vana, urged on by Fate, went into that asylum in company with Maricha. And that one (Maricha) commanding illusions, having drawn far the king's sons (Rama and Lakshmana\ he (Ravana) carried away Rama’s wife, slaying the vulture Jat&vu. And beholding the vulture slain and learning of the carrying off of Mithiia’s daughter, the descendant of Raghu, deprived of sense, bewailed in grief. And having with unassuaged sorrow burnt the vulture JatSyu, as he was searching for Sita in that wood, he fell in with a Rakshasa, K&vandha by name, of a dreadful and deformed shape. Having slain him, the mighty-armed one burnt his body, — and thereupon he went to heaven. And the Rakshasa addressed Rama, saying, “Do thou, O descendant of Raghu, repair unto the female ascetic, Savari, conversant with all systems of morality.”

Reparing to Savari, that destroyer of foes, gifted with exceeding energy, Rama, the son of Da^aratha, highly honored by Savari, met with Hanuman on the banks of the Pampa. Then, agreeably to Hanuman’s advice, the exceedingly powerful Rama saw Sugriva and detailed unto him all, specially touching Sita. Then the monkey Sugriva, having heard all from Rama, was well pleased with Rama and in the presence of fire, made friends with him. Then the king of monkeys, out of friendship, mournfully related unto him all about his hostilities with Vali. And then Rama vowed that he would slay Vali. Thereupon the monkey described unto Raghava the prowess of Vali, and he feared lest Rama should not prove a match for Vali.

And with the view of convincing Raghava (as to Vali's might), Sugriva showed unto him the huge corpse of Dundabhi, resembling a large hill. And looking at the skeleton, Rama endued with exceeding prowess, smiling the I while, with his toe cast it off at the distance of full ninety miles. And with a single mighty shaft he pierced seven palmyra palms, a hill, and the sixth nether world, carrying RlMlVANA. conviction into Sugriva. Thus convinced, the mighty monke 3 well pleased went with Rama towards the cave callec Kishkindi. And having arrived there, that best of monkeys | Sugriva of a tawney and golden hue, set up loud roarsj And at those mighty sounds, out came the lord of monkeys j and having obtained Tara’s consent, came before Sugriva for battle.

Then RSghava killed Vali on the spot with z .single shaft. And, in compliance with Sugriva's request having slain Vali in battle, Raghava conferred the kingdom on Sugriva. Then that best of monkeys having summoned all the various monkeys, sent them in various directions in search of Janaka’s daughter. Then at the suggestion of the vulture Samp&ti, the mighty Hanum&n crossed the salt sea extending for a hundred yojanas . And arriving at the city of Lanka, ruled by R5vana, he found Sita in the midst of an Asoka wood, absorbed in thought. And then having shown her the sign, he related unto her all about the friendship between R^ma and Sugriva, and having cheered Videha’s daughter, he smashed the gate of the palace.

Then having slain five generals, and seven counsellors’ sons, and grinded the heroic, Aksha, he was bound fast (by the arms of Indrajit). Then knowing] that in virtue of the grand-sire*s boon, he was free, he forgave those Rakshasas that were leading him (to Ravana). Then having burnt down the city of Lanka, with the exception of the place occupied by Mithila’s daughter, the mighty one returned, with the intention of delivering the glad tidings unto Rama. And that one of immeasurable soul having come before the high souled Rama, and circled him, addressed him, saying, — “I have truly seen Sita.” Then accopanied by Sugriva, Rama repaired to the shore of the mighty ocean, and with shafts resembling the sun, vexed the deep.

Then that! lord of rivers — the Ocean — showed himself. And agreeably! to the advice of the Ocean, Nala constructed a bridge (over, the water). By that bridge Rama went to the city of Lanka, — and slew Ravana in battle. And having recovered j bXlakXndam. JitSL, Rlma experienced high shame (\n consequence of 5it3k’s having lived so long in Ravana’s place), and used harsh anguage towards SitS in the presence of all. Incapable of >earing it, the chaste SitS. entered flaming fire. Thereupon assured by Agni as to the sinlessness of Sit«L, Rama became exceedingly pleased, and was honored by all the deities. And at the great act of Rama’s, the three worlds with all that was mobile and immobile in them, as well as the sages and gods, were well pleased with the mighty-souled Raghava.

Then installing that foremost of R&kshasas, Bibhisana, on the throne of LankSL, Rama was perfectly easy, and rejoiced exceedingly. Then R&ma, obtaining a boon from the celestials, revived the monkeys fallen in battle, and surrounded by friends, set out for Ayodhya on the car Pushpaka. And repairing to Bharadw&ja’s hermitage, R§ma, having truth for his prowess, despatched Hanuman to Bharata. Then talking over past affairs, accompanied with Sugriva, Rama, mounted on the Pushpaka, departed for Nandigr&ma. Having arrived at Nandigrima, the sinless Rama sheared himself of his matted locks along with his brothers, and, having regained Sita, got back his kingdom. And Da9aratha’s son, the auspicious R&ma, lord of AyodhS, hath been ruling those happy subjects of his, even like a father. (During his reign) his subjects will enjoy happiness, and contentment, and become hale, and grow in righteousness, and be devoid of mental disquietude and disease, and free from the fear of famine.

And no person is to witness his son’s death, and women will be ever chaste, and never bear widowhood. And no fear of conflagration (will exercise people), nor creatures be drowned in water. And no danger will come from the wind, ' — nor any suffer from fever. And no fear will come from hunger, lor from thieves. And cities and provinces will be filled with Corn and wealth. And all will live happily as at the Golden age, ^nd having performed with countless gold an hundred htprse sacrifices, and bestowed with due rites ayutas and JtiMll'A.VA. koits * of kine on learned persons, and countless wealth on famous Brahmanas, R&ghava will establish an hundred roya families, and will employ each of the four castes in its owr duties.

And having reigned for ten thousand and'as man) hundred years, Rlma will depart for the regions of Brahma He that readeth this sacred, sin-destroying, merit-bestowing history of RSma like unto the Veda itself, becometh cleansed from all sin. And the man that readeth this R£m&yana conferring length of days, after death, is honored in heaven, along with his sons, and grandsons, and relations. If a Br&hmana readeth it, he attaineth excellence in speech ; if a Kshatriya, he acquireth lordship over landed possessions ; if a Vaisya, abundance of wealth in trade ; and if a Sudra, greatness.”

verses.sa:
तपः स्वाध्यायनिरतं तपस्वी वाग्विदां वरम् ।
नारदं परिपप्रच्छ वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवम् ॥
verses.hi: तप और स्वाध्याय में निरत, वाणी के मर्मज्ञों में श्रेष्ठ देवर्षि नारद से तपस्वी मुनिश्रेष्ठ वाल्मीकि ने पूछा—
verses.en: The ascetic Vālmīki questioned Nārada—foremost of sages and best of those eloquent in speech, ever devoted to austerity and Vedic study:

verses.sa:
को न्वस्मिन्साम्प्रतं लोके गुणवान्कश्च वीर्यवान् ।
धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च सत्यवाक्यो दृढव्रतः ॥
verses.hi: इस समय इस संसार में कौन गुणवान् है और कौन पराक्रमी है? कौन धर्मज्ञ, कृतज्ञ, सत्यवादी और दृढ़व्रत है?
verses.en: “Who in this world today is endowed with virtue and great prowess? Who knows dharma, is grateful, speaks the truth, and is firm in his vows?

verses.sa:
चारित्रेण च को युक्तः सर्वभूतेषु को हितः ।
विद्वान्कः कः समर्थश्च कश्चैकप्रियदर्शनः ॥
verses.hi: सदाचार से युक्त कौन है, समस्त प्राणियों के हित में कौन रत रहता है, विद्वान् कौन है, समर्थ कौन है और एकमात्र प्रियदर्शन कौन है?
verses.en: Who is adorned with noble conduct, devoted to the welfare of all beings, wise, capable, and uniquely pleasing to behold?

verses.sa:
आत्मवान्को जितक्रोधो द्युतिमान्कोऽनसूयकः ।
कस्य बिभ्यति देवाश्च जातरोषस्य संयुगे ॥
verses.hi: जितेन्द्रिय कौन है, क्रोध को जीतने वाला कौन है, तेजस्वी और ईर्ष्यारहित कौन है तथा संग्राम में क्रुद्ध होने पर देवता भी किससे भयभीत रहते हैं?
verses.en: Who has mastered himself, conquered anger, shines with splendor, and is free from envy? And whom do even the gods fear when roused to wrath in battle?

verses.sa:
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे ।
महर्षे त्वं समर्थोऽसि ज्ञातुमेवंविधं नरम् ॥
verses.hi: हे महर्षि! यह मैं सुनना चाहता हूँ, क्योंकि मेरे मन में बड़ा कौतूहल है; आप ऐसे पुरुष को जानने में पूर्णतः समर्थ हैं।
verses.en: This I long to hear, for great is my curiosity; O great sage, you alone are able to know such a man.”

verses.sa:
श्रुत्वा चैतत्त्रिलोकज्ञो वाल्मीकेर्नारदो वचः ।
श्रूयतामिति चामन्त्र्य प्रहृष्टो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.hi: वाल्मीकि का यह वचन सुनकर तीनों लोकों के ज्ञाता नारद ने अत्यंत प्रसन्न होकर 'सुनिए' ऐसा कहकर उत्तर देना आरंभ किया—
verses.en: Hearing these words of Vālmīki, Nārada, knower of the three worlds, was greatly delighted and bade him listen, saying:

verses.sa:
बहवो दुर्लभाश्चैव ये त्वया कीर्तिता गुणाः ।
मुने वक्ष्याम्यहं बुद्ध्वा तैर्युक्तः श्रूयतां नरः ॥
verses.hi: हे मुने! आपने जिन गुणों का वर्णन किया है वे अनेक और दुर्लभ हैं; फिर भी मैं विचारकर उन सभी से युक्त पुरुष के विषय में कहता हूँ, आप सुनिए।
verses.en: “Many and rare indeed are the virtues you have named; yet having considered well, O sage, I shall tell you of one endowed with them—listen!

verses.sa:
इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः ।
नियतात्मा महावीर्यो द्युतिमान्धृतिमान्वशी ॥
verses.hi: इक्ष्वाकु वंश में उत्पन्न, लोगों में 'राम' नाम से विख्यात एक पुरुष हैं; वे संयमित चित्त वाले, महाबलशाली, तेजस्वी, धैर्यवान् और जितेन्द्रिय हैं।
verses.en: Born in the lineage of Ikṣvāku is one renowned among men by the name of Rāma: self-controlled, of mighty valor, radiant, steadfast, and master of his senses.

verses.sa:
बुद्धिमान्नीतिमान्वाग्मी श्रीमाञ्छ्त्रुनिबर्हणः ।
विपुलांसो महाबाहुः कम्बुग्रीवो महाहनुः ॥
verses.hi: वे बुद्धिमान्, नीतिज्ञ, मधुरभाषी, श्रीसम्पन्न और शत्रुओं का नाश करने वाले हैं; उनके कंधे चौड़े, भुजाएँ विशाल, ग्रीवा शंख के समान और ठोड़ी पुष्ट है।
verses.en: He is wise, skilled in statecraft, eloquent, illustrious, and a destroyer of foes; broad-shouldered, mighty-armed, with a conch-shaped neck and strong jaw.

verses.sa:
महोरस्को महेष्वासो गूढजत्रुररिन्दमः ।
आजानुबाहुः सुशिराः सुललाटः सुविक्रमः ॥
verses.hi: वे विशाल वक्षस्थल वाले, महान धनुर्धर, गूढ़ हँसली वाले और शत्रुदमन हैं; उनकी भुजाएँ घुटनों तक लंबी, सिर सुंदर, ललाट भव्य और पराक्रम अद्भुत है।
verses.en: Broad-chested and a great archer, with well-covered collarbones and subduing his enemies, his arms reach his knees; he has a noble head, a fair forehead, and glorious stride.

verses.sa:
समः समविभक्ताङ्गः स्निग्धवर्णः प्रतापवान् ।
पीनवक्षा विशालाक्षो लक्ष्मीवाञ्छुभलक्षणः ॥
verses.hi: उनका शरीर समान और सुगठित है, वर्ण स्निग्ध है और वे अत्यंत प्रतापी हैं; वे चौड़ी छाती, विशाल नेत्र, शोभा तथा शुभ लक्षणों से युक्त हैं।
verses.en: Well-proportioned with symmetrical limbs, lustrous complexion, and great majesty, he is deep-chested, large-eyed, auspicious, and marked with every lucky sign.

verses.sa:
धर्मज्ञः सत्यसन्धश्च प्रजानां च हिते रतः ।
यशस्वी ज्ञानसम्पन्नः शुचिर्वश्यः समाधिमान् ॥
verses.hi: वे धर्म के ज्ञाता, सत्यप्रतिज्ञ और प्रजा के हित में तत्पर रहते हैं; वे यशस्वी, ज्ञानसम्पन्न, पवित्र, विनम्र और समाहित चित्त वाले हैं।
verses.en: Knower of dharma, true to his promise, and devoted to the welfare of his people, he is famed, rich in knowledge, pure, self-restrained, and composed in mind.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिसमः श्रीमान् धाता रिपुनिषूदनः ।
रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य धर्मस्य परिरक्षिता ॥
verses.hi: वे प्रजापति ब्रह्मा के समान पालक, लक्ष्मीवान्, विश्व के आधार और शत्रुओं का संहार करने वाले हैं; वे समस्त जीवजगत के रक्षक और धर्म के परिरक्षक हैं।
verses.en: Like Prajāpati in majesty, prosperous, the sustainer of all, and slayer of foes, he is the protector of the living world and guardian of dharma.

verses.sa:
रक्षिता स्वस्य धर्मस्य स्वजनस्य च रक्षिता  ।
वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो धनुर्वेदे च निष्ठितः ॥
verses.hi: वे अपने धर्म तथा स्वजनों की रक्षा करने वाले, वेद और वेदांगों के तत्त्वज्ञ तथा धनुर्वेद में पूर्ण निष्ठा रखने वाले हैं।
verses.en: Protector of his own duty and of his kinsmen, he knows the true essence of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas and is deeply accomplished in the science of archery.

verses.sa:
सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञो स्मृतिमान् प्रतिभानवान् ।
सर्वलोकप्रियः साधुरदीनात्मा विचक्षणः ॥
verses.hi: वे समस्त शास्त्रों के अर्थ और तत्त्व के ज्ञाता, उत्तम स्मरणशक्ति वाले और प्रतिभाशाली हैं; वे सर्वलोकप्रिय, साधुस्वभाव, अदीन आत्मा और अत्यंत निपुण हैं।
verses.en: Versed in the true meaning of all scriptures, gifted with sharp memory and keen intellect, he is dear to all worlds, gentle, undaunted in spirit, and discerning.

verses.sa:
सर्वदाभिगतः सद्भिः समुद्र इव सिन्धुभिः ।
आर्यः सर्वसमश्चैव सदैव प्रियदर्शनः ॥
verses.hi: जैसे नदियाँ समुद्र में मिलती हैं, वैसे ही सत्पुरुष सदा उनके पास आते हैं; वे आर्य (श्रेष्ठ), सबके प्रति समदर्शी और सदा प्रियदर्शन हैं।
verses.en: Ever sought out by the good as the ocean is by rivers, he is noble, equal in regard toward all, and always lovely to behold.

verses.sa:
स च सर्व गुणोपेतः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः ।
समुद्र इव गाम्भीर्ये  धैर्येण हिमवानिव ॥
verses.hi: कौसल्या के आनंद को बढ़ाने वाले वे राम सब गुणों से सम्पन्न हैं; गंभीरता में वे समुद्र के समान और धैर्य में हिमालय के समान अटल हैं।
verses.en: Endowed with every virtue and enhancer of Kausalyā’s joy, he is like the ocean in depth and like the Himālaya in steadfastness.

verses.sa:
विष्णुना सदृशो वीर्ये सोमवत्प्रियदर्शनः ।
कालाग्निसदृशः क्रोधे क्षमया पृथिवीसमः ॥
verses.hi: पराक्रम में वे विष्णु के समान हैं और दर्शन में चंद्रमा के समान प्रिय हैं; क्रोध में वे कालाग्नि के सदृश और क्षमा में पृथ्वी के समान हैं।
verses.en: In valor he equals Viṣṇu, in pleasing grace the moon; in anger he resembles the fire of dissolution, and in forbearance he is like the Earth.

verses.sa:
धनदेन समस्त्यागे सत्ये धर्म इवापरः ।
तमेवंगुणसम्पन्नं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् ॥
verses.hi: त्याग में वे कुबेर के समान और सत्य में मानो दूसरे धर्मराज ही हैं। ऐसे सद्गुणों से सम्पन्न और सत्यपराक्रमी राम को—
verses.en: In generosity he rivals Kubera, and in truth he is like a second Dharma. That Rāma, endowed with such virtues and true in prowess—

verses.sa:
ज्येष्ठं ज्येष्ठगुणैर्युक्तं प्रियं दशरथस्सुतम् ।
प्रकृतीनां हितैर्युक्तं प्रकृतिप्रियकाम्यया ॥
verses.hi: जो ज्येष्ठ पुत्र होने के साथ श्रेष्ठ गुणों से युक्त, दशरथ के अत्यंत प्रिय तथा प्रजा के हितसाधन में तत्पर थे—प्रजा के कल्याण की कामना से
verses.en: his eldest son, adorned with supreme qualities, dear to Daśaratha, and dedicated to the people’s welfare—desiring what would please his subjects,

verses.sa:
यौवराज्येन संयोक्तुम् ऐच्छत्प्रीत्या महीपतिः ।
तस्याभिषेकसम्भारान् दृष्ट्वा भार्याथ कैकयी ॥
verses.hi: महाराज दशरथ ने प्रेमपूर्वक युवराज पद पर अभिषिक्त करना चाहा। किंतु अभिषेक की तैयारी देखकर उनकी पत्नी कैकेयी ने—
verses.en: King Daśaratha wished lovingly to anoint as crown prince. Seeing the preparations for his consecration, Queen Kaikeyī,

verses.sa:
पूर्वं दत्तवरा देवी वरमेनमयाचत ।
विवासनञ्च रामस्य भरतस्याभिषेचनम् ॥
verses.hi: जिसे राजा ने पहले वर देने का वचन दिया था—वे वर माँगे कि राम को वनवास दिया जाए और भरत का राज्याभिषेक हो।
verses.en: to whom the king had earlier granted boons, asked for this boon: the exile of Rāma and the coronation of Bharata.

verses.sa:
स सत्यवचनाद्राजा धर्मपाशेन संयतः ।
विवासयामास सुतं रामं दशरथः प्रियम् ॥
verses.hi: सत्यवचन वाले राजा दशरथ ने धर्म के बंधन में बँधकर अपने अत्यंत प्रिय पुत्र राम को वनवास दे दिया।
verses.en: True to his word and bound by the bonds of dharma, King Daśaratha banished his beloved son Rāma.

verses.sa:
स जगाम वनं वीरः प्रतिज्ञामनुपालयन् ।
पितुर्वचननिर्देशात् कैकेय्याः प्रियकारणात् ॥
verses.hi: पिता के वचन के पालन और कैकेयी की प्रसन्नता के लिए वे वीर राम अपनी प्रतिज्ञा निभाते हुए वन को चल पड़े।
verses.en: Upholding his pledge at his father’s command and to fulfill Kaikeyī’s wish, the hero departed for the forest.

verses.sa:
तं व्रजन्तं प्रियो भ्राता लक्ष्मणोऽनुजगाम ह ।
स्नेहाद् विनयसम्पन्नः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः ॥
verses.hi: वन जाते हुए उनके पीछे सुमित्रा के आनंदवर्धन, स्नेही और विनयसम्पन्न प्रिय भाई लक्ष्मण भी चल दिए।
verses.en: As he set out, his beloved brother Lakṣmaṇa—enhancer of Sumitrā’s joy, humble and filled with affection—followed him,

verses.sa:
भ्रातरं दयितो भ्रातुः सौभ्रात्रमनुदर्शयन् ।
रामस्य दयिता भार्या नित्यं प्राणसमा हिता ॥
verses.hi: भाई के प्रति सच्चा भ्रातृप्रेम प्रकट करते हुए प्रिय लक्ष्मण ने उनका अनुसरण किया। राम की प्राणों के समान प्रिय और सदा हितैषिणी पत्नी—
verses.en: dear to his brother and revealing true brotherly devotion. And Rāma’s beloved wife, ever as dear to him as life and devoted to his good,

verses.sa:
जनकस्य कुले जाता देवमायेव निर्मिता ।
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्ना नारीणामुत्तमा वधूः ॥
verses.hi: जो राजा जनक के कुल में उत्पन्न, देवमाया से निर्मित-सी प्रतीत होने वाली, सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्ना और नारियों में उत्तम वधू थीं—
verses.en: born in the lineage of Janaka, seeming fashioned by divine grace, endowed with every auspicious mark and foremost among women,

verses.sa:
सीताप्यनुगता रामं शशिनं रोहिणी यथा ।
पौरैरनुगतो दूरं पित्रा दशरथेन च ॥
verses.hi: वह सीता भी चंद्रमा के पीछे रोहिणी के समान राम के साथ चल पड़ीं। नगरवासियों और पिता दशरथ के द्वारा दूर तक अनुसरण किए गए राम ने
verses.en: Sītā too followed Rāma as Rohiṇī follows the moon. Followed far by the citizens and by his father Daśaratha,

verses.sa:
शृङ्गवीरपुरे सूतं गङ्गाकूले व्यसर्जयत् ।
गुहमासाद्य धर्मात्मा निषादाधिपतिं प्रियम् ॥
verses.hi: शृंगवेरपुर में गंगा के तट पर निषादराज प्रिय तथा धर्मात्मा गुह से भेंट करके अपने सारथि सुमन्त्र को विदा कर दिया।
verses.en: the righteous Rāma met his dear friend Guha, chief of the Niṣādas, at Śṛṅgaverapura on the bank of the Gaṅgā, and dismissed his charioteer.

verses.sa:
गुहेन सहितो रामो लक्ष्मणेन च सीतया ।
ते वनेन वनङ्गत्वा नदीस्तीर्त्वा बहूदकाः ॥
verses.hi: गुह के साथ राम, लक्ष्मण और सीता एक वन से दूसरे वन जाते हुए तथा अनेक जलपूर्ण नदियों को पार करते हुए
verses.en: Together with Guha, Lakṣmaṇa, and Sītā, traveling from forest to forest and crossing many deep rivers,

verses.sa:
चित्रकूटमनुप्राप्य भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ।
रम्यमावसथं कृत्वा रममाणा वने त्रयः ॥
verses.hi: महर्षि भरद्वाज के निर्देश से चित्रकूट पर्वत पर पहुँचे और वहाँ सुंदर कुटिया बनाकर वे तीनों वन में आनंदपूर्वक निवास करने लगे।
verses.en: they reached Mount Citrakūṭa at Bharadvāja’s direction, built a pleasant hermitage, and dwelt happily in the woods—

verses.sa:
देवगन्धर्वसंकाशाः तत्र ते न्यवसन् सुखम् ।
चित्रकूटङ्गते रामे पुत्रशोकातुरस्तथा ॥
verses.hi: देवताओं और गंधर्वों के समान तेजस्वी वे तीनों वहाँ सुखपूर्वक रहने लगे। राम के चित्रकूट चले जाने पर पुत्रशोक से व्याकुल
verses.en: the three of them living there in joy like gods and gandharvas. When Rāma had gone to Citrakūṭa, stricken with grief for his son,

verses.sa:
राजा दशरथस्स्वर्गं जगाम विलपन् सुतम्  ।
गते तु तस्मिन् भरतो वसिष्ठप्रमुखैर्द्विजैः ॥
verses.hi: राजा दशरथ पुत्र के लिए विलाप करते हुए स्वर्ग सिधार गए। उनके स्वर्गवास पर वसिष्ठ आदि ब्राह्मणों के द्वारा
verses.en: King Daśaratha ascended to heaven lamenting his child. After his passing, Bharata, urged by Vasiṣṭha and the foremost brāhmaṇas

verses.sa:
नियुज्यमानो राज्याय नैच्छत् राज्यं महाबलः ।
स जगाम वनं वीरो रामपादप्रसादकः ॥
verses.hi: राज्य पर नियुक्त किए जाने पर भी महाबली भरत ने राज्य स्वीकार नहीं किया, बल्कि वे वीर राम के चरणों को प्रसन्न करने वन की ओर चल दिए।
verses.en: to assume the kingdom, did not desire the throne; that mighty hero went into the forest to win Rāma’s favor.

verses.sa:
गत्वा तु स महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् ।
अयाचद्भ्रातरं रामम् आर्यभावपुरस्कृतः ॥
verses.hi: वहाँ जाकर उन्होंने श्रेष्ठ भाव को आगे रखकर महात्मा तथा सत्यपराक्रमी भाई राम से प्रार्थना की—
verses.en: Approaching the great-souled Rāma of true valor, he entreated his brother with noble reverence:

verses.sa:
त्वमेव राजा धर्मज्ञ इति रामं वचोऽब्रवीत् ।
रामोऽपि परमोदारः सुमुखस्सुमहायशाः ॥
verses.hi: 'हे धर्मज्ञ! आप ही राजा हैं।' ऐसा उन्होंने राम से कहा। अत्यंत उदार, प्रसन्नमुख और महायशस्वी राम ने भी
verses.en: ‘You alone, O knower of dharma, are king,’ he said to Rāma. Yet the supremely generous, gracious, and renowned Rāma

verses.sa:
न चैच्छत् पितुरादेशात् राज्यं रामो महाबलः ।
पादुके चास्य राज्याय न्यासं दत्त्वा पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.hi: पिता की आज्ञा के कारण महाबली होते हुए भी राज्य नहीं चाहा; और उन्होंने राज्य की धरोहर के रूप में अपनी पादुकाएँ भरत को बार-बार समझाकर दीं।
verses.en: did not desire the kingdom, obeying his father’s command; entrusting his sandals to Bharata as a pledge for the realm, again and again

verses.sa:
निवर्तयामास ततो भरतं भरताग्रजः ।
स काममनवाप्यैव रामपादावुपस्पृशन् ॥
verses.hi: तब भरत के बड़े भाई राम ने भरत को लौटा दिया। भरत भी अपनी इच्छा पूरी न होने पर राम की पादुकाओं का स्पर्श कर
verses.en: Rāma persuaded Bharata to turn back. His wish unfulfilled, Bharata touched Rāma’s feet

verses.sa:
नन्दिग्रामेऽकरोद् राज्यं रामागमनकाङ्क्षया ।
गते तु भरते श्रीमान् सत्यसन्धो जितेन्द्रियः ॥
verses.hi: नन्दिग्राम में रहकर राम के आगमन की प्रतीक्षा करते हुए राज्य का संचालन करने लगे। भरत के चले जाने पर श्रीमान्, सत्यप्रतिज्ञ और जितेन्द्रिय
verses.en: and governed the kingdom from Nandigrāma, awaiting Rāma’s return. When Bharata had departed, the illustrious, truthful, self-controlled

verses.sa:
रामस्तु पुनरालक्ष्य नागरस्य जनस्य च ।
तत्रागमनमेकाग्रो दण्डकान् प्रविवेश ह ॥
verses.hi: राम ने पुनः नगरवासियों और प्रजाजनों के वहाँ आने की संभावना देख एकाग्रचित्त होकर दण्डकारण्य में प्रवेश किया।
verses.en: Rāma, perceiving that townsfolk and others would come there again, entered the Daṇḍaka forest with resolute mind.

verses.sa:
प्रविश्य तु महारण्यं रामो राजीवलोचनः ।
विराधं राक्षसं हत्वा शरभङ्गं ददर्श ह ॥
verses.hi: महावन में प्रवेश करके कमलनयन राम ने विराध नामक राक्षस का वध किया और महर्षि शरभंग के दर्शन किए।
verses.en: Entering that great forest, lotus-eyed Rāma slew the rākṣasa Virādha and visited the sage Śarabhaṅga,

verses.sa:
सुतीक्ष्णं चाप्यगस्त्यं च अगस्त्यभ्रातरं तथा ।
अगस्त्यवचनाच्चैव जग्राहैन्द्रं शरासनम् ॥
verses.hi: उन्होंने सुतीक्ष्ण, अगस्त्य तथा अगस्त्य के भ्राता का भी दर्शन किया, और अगस्त्य ऋषि के वचन से दिव्य ऐन्द्र धनुष,
verses.en: as well as Sutīkṣṇa, Agastya, and Agastya’s brother; and at Agastya’s word he received Indra’s bow,

verses.sa:
खड्गञ्च परम प्रीतस्तूणी चाक्षयसायकौ ।
वसतस्तस्य रामस्य वने वनचरैः सह ॥
verses.hi: खड्ग तथा कभी खाली न होने वाले बाणों से भरे दो तरकश अत्यंत प्रसन्नता से ग्रहण किए। वनवासियों के साथ वन में निवास करते हुए उन राम के पास
verses.en: a sword, and two quivers of inexhaustible arrows with great delight. While Rāma dwelt in the woods with the forest-dwellers,

verses.sa:
ऋषयोऽभ्यागमन् सर्वे वधायासुररक्षसाम् ।
स तेषां प्रतिशुश्राव राक्षसानां तदा वने ॥
verses.hi: असुरों और राक्षसों के वध की प्रार्थना लेकर सभी ऋषिगण आए; तब राम ने वन में उन राक्षसों के संहार की प्रतिज्ञा की।
verses.en: all the sages came to him seeking the destruction of the asuras and rākṣasas; and there in the forest he gave them his pledge

verses.sa:
प्रतिज्ञातश्च रामेण वधः संयति रक्षसाम् ।
ऋषीणामग्निकल्पानां दण्डकारण्यवासीनाम् ॥
verses.hi: दण्डकारण्य में निवास करने वाले अग्नितुल्य तेजस्वी ऋषियों के समक्ष राम ने संग्राम में राक्षसों के वध का वचन दिया।
verses.en: to slay the rākṣasas in battle, promising this before those fire-bright sages dwelling in the Daṇḍaka forest.

verses.sa:
तेन तत्रैव वसता जनस्थाननिवासिनी ।
विरूपिता शूर्पणखा राक्षसी कामरूपिणी ॥
verses.hi: वहीं रहते हुए उनके द्वारा जनस्थान में निवास करने वाली कामरूपिणी राक्षसी शूर्पणखा का विरूपण किया गया।
verses.en: While living there, he disfigured Śūrpaṇakhā, the shapeshifting rākṣasī dwelling in Janasthāna.

verses.sa:
ततः शूर्पणखावाक्यादुद्युक्तान् सर्वराक्षसान् ।
खरं त्रिशिरसं चैव दूषणं चैव राक्षसम् ॥
verses.hi: तब शूर्पणखा के कहने से युद्ध के लिए उद्यत हुए सभी राक्षसों तथा खर, त्रिशिरा और दूषण को
verses.en: Then all the rākṣasas roused by Śūrpaṇakhā’s words—Khara, Triśiras, and the rākṣasa Dūṣaṇa,

verses.sa:
निजघान रणे रामस्तेषां चैव पदानुगान् ।
वने तस्मिन् निवसता जनस्थाननिवासिनाम् ॥
verses.hi: राम ने रणभूमि में उनके अनुचरों सहित मार गिराया। उस वन में जनस्थान के निवासी
verses.en: together with their followers—Rāma slew in battle. While dwelling in that forest, of the rākṣasas of Janasthāna,

verses.sa:
रक्षसां निहतान्यासन् सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ।
ततो ज्ञातिवधं श्रुत्वा रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः ॥
verses.hi: चौदह सहस्र राक्षस मारे गए। तब अपने स्वजनों के वध का समाचार सुनकर रावण क्रोध से मूर्च्छित हो उठा।
verses.en: fourteen thousand were slain. Hearing of the slaughter of his kinsmen, Rāvaṇa, overcome with fury,

verses.sa:
सहायं वरयामास मारीचं नाम राक्षसम् ।
वार्यमाणः सुबहुशो मारीचेन स रावणः ॥
verses.hi: उसने मारीच नामक राक्षस को अपना सहायक चुना। मारीच के द्वारा बार-बार रोके जाने पर भी—
verses.en: sought the help of a rākṣasa named Mārīca. Though repeatedly warned by Mārīca—

verses.sa:
न विरोधो बलवता क्षमो रावण तेन ते ।
अनादृत्य तु तद्वाक्यं रावणः कालचोदितः ॥
verses.hi: 'हे रावण! बलवान् राम से तुम्हारा विरोध करना उचित नहीं है'—इस बात की उपेक्षा कर काल से प्रेरित रावण
verses.en: ‘O Rāvaṇa, hostility with that mighty one is not wise for you’—Rāvaṇa, driven by fate, disregarded his counsel

verses.sa:
जगाम सहमारीचस्तस्याश्रमपदं तदा ।
तेन मायाविना दूरमपवाह्य नृपात्मजौ ॥
verses.hi: मारीच को साथ लेकर राम के आश्रम के समीप गया। उस मायावी मारीच के द्वारा दोनों राजकुमारों को दूर ले जाए जाने पर
verses.en: and went with Mārīca to Rāma’s hermitage. After that master of illusion lured the two princes far away,

verses.sa:
जहार भार्यां रामस्य गृध्रं हत्वा जटायुषम् ।
गृध्रञ्च निहतं दृष्ट्वा हृतां श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम् ॥
verses.hi: रावण ने गीधराज जटायु का वध करके राम की पत्नी का हरण कर लिया। जटायु को आहत देख और मैथिली सीता के हरण का समाचार सुनकर
verses.en: Rāvaṇa abducted Rāma’s wife, slaying the vulture Jaṭāyu. Seeing the vulture struck down and hearing that Sītā of Mithilā had been carried off,

verses.sa:
राघवः शोकसंतप्तो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः ।
ततस्तेनैव शोकेन गृध्रं दग्ध्वा जटायुषम् ॥
verses.hi: शोक से संतप्त राघव व्याकुल इन्द्रियों वाले होकर विलाप करने लगे। फिर उसी शोक में जटायु का दाह-संस्कार करके
verses.en: Rāghava, consumed with grief and agitated in his senses, lamented; then in that same sorrow he cremated Jaṭāyu

verses.sa:
मार्गमाणो वने सीतां राक्षसं सन्ददर्श ह ।
कबन्धं नाम रूपेण विकृतं घोरदर्शनम् ॥
verses.hi: वन में सीता को खोजते हुए उन्होंने अत्यंत विकृत रूप और भयंकर आकृति वाला कबन्ध नामक राक्षस देखा।
verses.en: and, searching the forest for Sītā, encountered a hideous, terrifying rākṣasa named Kabandha.

verses.sa:
तन्निहत्य महाबाहुर्ददाह स्वर्गतश्च सः ।
स चास्य कथयामास शबरीं धर्मचारिणीम् ॥
verses.hi: महाबाहु राम ने उसे मारकर उसका दाह-संस्कार किया और वह दिव्य रूप धारण कर स्वर्ग चला गया; जाते-जाते उसने धर्मचारिणी शबरी के बारे में बताया—
verses.en: Slaying him, the mighty-armed Rāma cremated his body, whereupon he ascended to heaven; and Kabandha told him of the righteous Śabarī:

verses.sa:
श्रमणां धर्मनिपुणामभिगच्छेति राघव ।
सोऽभ्य गच्छन्महातेजाः शबरीं शत्रुसूदनः ॥
verses.hi: 'हे राघव! आप धर्म में निपुण श्रमणा शबरी के आश्रम में जाइए।' तब महातेजस्वी और शत्रुसूदन राम शबरी के पास गए।
verses.en: ‘Go, O Rāghava, to the ascetic woman Śabarī, steeped in dharma.’ That radiant destroyer of foes accordingly went to Śabarī.

verses.sa:
शबर्या पूजितः सम्यग् रामो दशरथात्मजः ।
पम्पातीरे हनुमता सङ्गतो वानरेण ह ॥
verses.hi: दशरथनन्दन राम का शबरी ने भलीभाँति पूजन किया। इसके बाद पम्पा सरोवर के तट पर वानर हनुमान् से उनकी भेंट हुई।
verses.en: Duly honored by Śabarī, Rāma son of Daśaratha met the vānara Hanumān on the shore of Lake Pampā.

verses.sa:
हनुमद्वचनाच्चैव सुग्रीवेण समागतः ।
सुग्रीवाय च तत्सर्वं शंसद्रामो महाबलः ॥
verses.hi: हनुमान् के वचन से राम का सुग्रीव से मिलन हुआ, और महाबली राम ने सुग्रीव को वह सारा वृत्तान्त सुनाया—
verses.en: At Hanumān’s word he met Sugrīva, and mighty Rāma recounted to Sugrīva everything that had occurred,

verses.sa:
आदितस्तद् यथावृत्तं सीतायाश्च विशेषतः ।
सुग्रीवश्चापि तत्सर्वं श्रुत्वा रामस्य वानरः ॥
verses.hi: विशेषकर आरंभ से सीता के हरण तक जो कुछ घटित हुआ था। वानरराज सुग्रीव ने भी राम की सारी कथा सुनकर
verses.en: from the beginning, and especially all concerning Sītā. Hearing everything from Rāma, the vānara Sugrīva

verses.sa:
चकार सख्यं रामेण प्रीतश्चैवाग्निसाक्षिकम् ।
ततो वानरराजेन वैरानुकथनं प्रति ॥
verses.hi: प्रसन्न होकर अग्नि को साक्षी बनाकर राम के साथ मित्रता स्थापित की। तब वानरराज सुग्रीव ने अपने भाई से हुए वैर का वर्णन करते हुए
verses.en: joyfully forged a friendship with Rāma with fire as witness. Then the vānara king, in sorrow and affection,

verses.sa:
रामायावेदितं सर्वं प्रणयात् दुःखितेन च ।
प्रतिज्ञातञ्च रामेण तदा वालिवधं प्रति ॥
verses.hi: प्रेम और दुःख के साथ राम को सब कुछ निवेदन किया; और उस समय राम ने वालि के वध की प्रतिज्ञा की।
verses.en: told Rāma the whole story of his feud with Vālin; and Rāma thereupon vowed to slay Vālin.

verses.sa:
वालिनश्च बलं तत्र कथयामास वानरः ।
सुग्रीवः शङ्कितश्चासीन्नित्यं वीर्येण राघवे ॥
verses.hi: तब सुग्रीव ने वालि के अपार बल का वर्णन किया, क्योंकि सुग्रीव के मन में राम के पराक्रम के प्रति शंका बनी हुई थी।
verses.en: Sugrīva then described Vālin’s immense strength, for Sugrīva still harbored doubt regarding Rāghava’s might.

verses.sa:
राघवप्रत्ययार्थं तु दुन्दुभेः कायमुत्तमम् ।
दर्शयामास सुग्रीवः महापर्वतसन्निभम् ॥
verses.hi: अतः राघव में विश्वास उत्पन्न करने के लिए सुग्रीव ने दुन्दुभि असुर का विशाल पर्वत के समान भारी कंकाल दिखाया।
verses.en: To test Rāghava’s prowess, Sugrīva showed him the colossal skeleton of Dundubhi, huge as a mountain.

verses.sa:
उत्स्मयित्वा महाबाहुः प्रेक्ष्य चास्ति महाबलः ।
पादाङ्गुष्ठेन चिक्षेप संपूर्णं दशयोजनम् ॥
verses.hi: महाबाहु और महाबलशाली राम ने उसे देखकर मुस्कराते हुए अपने पैर के अंगूठे से ही पूरे दस योजन दूर फेंक दिया।
verses.en: Smiling as he looked upon it, the mighty-armed hero kicked it a full ten yojanas away with his big toe,

verses.sa:
बिभेद च पुनस्सालान् सप्तैकेन महेषुणा ।
गिरिं रसातलञ्चैव जनयन् प्रत्ययं तथा ॥
verses.hi: और विश्वास दिलाने के लिए उन्होंने एक ही महाबाण से सात ताड़ के वृक्षों, एक पर्वत तथा रसातल तक को वेध दिया।
verses.en: and with a single mighty arrow pierced seven sāla trees, a mountain, and the netherworld, thus inspiring full confidence.

verses.sa:
ततः प्रीतमनास्तेन विश्वस्तस्स महाकपिः ।
किष्किन्धां रामसहितो जगाम च गुहां तदा ॥
verses.hi: तब प्रसन्नचित्त और पूर्ण विश्वस्त होकर महाकपि सुग्रीव राम के साथ किष्किन्धा की गुफा में गया।
verses.en: Delighted and reassured, the great vānara then went with Rāma to the cavern of Kiṣkindhā.

verses.sa:
ततोऽगर्जद्धरिवरः सुग्रीवो हेमपिङ्गलः ।
तेन नादेन महता निर्जगाम हरीश्वरः ॥
verses.hi: वहाँ सुवर्ण के समान कान्ति वाले वानरश्रेष्ठ सुग्रीव ने जोर से गर्जना की, और उस महानाद को सुनकर वानरराज वालि बाहर निकला।
verses.en: There the tawny-golden foremost of vānaras, Sugrīva, thundered aloud; at that mighty roar, the vānara king Vālin came forth.

verses.sa:
अनुमान्य तदा तारां सुग्रीवेण समागतः ।
निजघान च तत्रैनं शरेणैकेन राघवः ॥
verses.hi: उस समय तारा को समझा-बुझाकर वालि सुग्रीव से भिड़ गया, और वहीं राघव ने एक ही बाण से वालि का वध कर दिया।
verses.en: Reassuring Tārā, Vālin engaged Sugrīva in combat, and there Rāghava slew him with a single arrow.

verses.sa:
ततः सुग्रीववचनात् हत्वा वालिनमाहवे ।
सुग्रीवमेव तद्राज्ये राघवः प्रत्यपादयत् ॥
verses.hi: सुग्रीव के कहे अनुसार युद्ध में वालि का वध करके राघव ने सुग्रीव को ही उस राज्य पर प्रतिष्ठित किया।
verses.en: Having slain Vālin in battle at Sugrīva’s request, Rāghava established Sugrīva upon that kingdom.

verses.sa:
स च सर्वान् समानीय वानरान् वानरर्षभः ।
दिशः प्रस्थापयामास दिदृक्षुर्जनकात्मजाम् ॥
verses.hi: वानरों में श्रेष्ठ सुग्रीव ने सभी वानरों को एकत्र करके जनकनन्दिनी सीता की खोज के लिए चारों दिशाओं में भेजा।
verses.en: Summoning all the vānaras, that chief of vānaras dispatched them in every direction in search of Janaka’s daughter.

verses.sa:
ततो गृध्रस्य वचनात् संपातेर्हनुमान् बली ।
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं पुप्लुवे लवणार्णवम् ॥
verses.hi: तदनन्तर गीधराज सम्पाति के वचन से बलशाली हनुमान् ने सौ योजन विस्तृत लवण समुद्र को लाँघ दिया।
verses.en: Then, acting on the words of the vulture Sampāti, mighty Hanumān leaped across the salt ocean a hundred yojanas wide.

verses.sa:
तत्र लङ्कां समासाद्य पुरीं रावणपालिताम् ।
ददर्श सीतां ध्यायन्तीम् अशोकवनिकां गताम् ॥
verses.hi: वहाँ रावण के द्वारा सुरक्षित लंकापुरी में पहुँचकर उन्होंने अशोकवाटिका में ध्यानमग्न बैठी हुई सीता को देखा।
verses.en: Reaching the city of Laṅkā ruled by Rāvaṇa, he saw Sītā lost in meditation in the Aśoka grove.

verses.sa:
निवेदयित्वाभिज्ञानं प्रवृत्तिं विनिवेद्य च ।
समाश्वास्य च वैदेहीं मर्दयामास तोरणम् ॥
verses.hi: अभिज्ञान (अंगूठी) और राम का समाचार निवेदन करके तथा वैदेही को आश्वासन देकर उन्होंने वाटिका के तोरण को ध्वस्त कर दिया।
verses.en: Presenting the token ring, delivering Rāma’s tidings, and comforting Vaidehī, he shattered the archway of the grove.

verses.sa:
पञ्च सेनाग्रगान् हत्वा सप्त मन्त्रिसुतानपि ।
शूरमक्षं च निष्पिष्य ग्रहणं समुपागमत् ॥
verses.hi: पाँच सेनापतियों तथा सात मन्त्रिपुत्रों का वध कर और शूरवीर अक्षकुमार को कुचलकर हनुमान् बंदी बन गए।
verses.en: Slaying five army commanders and seven ministers’ sons, and crushing the valiant Akṣa, he allowed himself to be captured.

verses.sa:
अस्त्रेणोन्मुक्तमात्मानं ज्ञात्वा पैतामहाद् वरात्  ।
मर्षयन् राक्षसान् वीरो यन्त्रिणस्तान् यदृच्छया ॥
verses.hi: ब्रह्मा के वरदान के कारण स्वयं को ब्रह्मास्त्र से मुक्त जानते हुए भी उन वीर हनुमान् ने स्वेच्छा से उन राक्षसों का बंधन सहन किया।
verses.en: Knowing he was free from the weapon through Brahmā’s boon, the hero willingly bore the rākṣasas who bound him.

verses.sa:
ततो दग्ध्वा पुरीं लङ्काम् ऋते सीताञ्च मैथिलीम् ।
रामाय प्रियमाख्यातुं पुनरायान्महाकपिः ॥
verses.hi: तदनन्तर सीता जी के स्थान को छोड़कर शेष लंकापुरी को जलाकर वे महाकपि राम को यह प्रिय समाचार देने लौट आए।
verses.en: Then, after burning the city of Laṅkā—sparing the place of Maithilī Sītā—the great vānara returned to bring Rāma the joyful news.

verses.sa:
सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानं कृत्वा रामं प्रदक्षिणम् ।
न्यवेदयदमेयात्मा दृष्टा सीतेति तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.hi: महात्मा राम के पास पहुँचकर और उनकी प्रदक्षिणा करके अमित तेजस्वी हनुमान् ने निवेदन किया कि 'मैंने वास्तव में सीता को देख लिया है।'
verses.en: Approaching great-souled Rāma and circumambulating him, the immeasurable Hanumān declared: ‘Truly I have seen Sītā.’

verses.sa:
ततः सुग्रीवसहितो गत्वा तीरं महोदधेः ।
समुद्रं क्षोभयामास शरैरादित्यसन्निभैः ॥
verses.hi: इसके बाद सुग्रीव सहित महासमुद्र के तट पर जाकर राम ने सूर्य के समान तेजस्वी बाणों से समुद्र को क्षुब्ध कर दिया।
verses.en: Then, accompanied by Sugrīva, Rāma went to the shore of the great ocean and agitated the sea with sun-bright arrows.

verses.sa:
दर्शयामास चात्मानं समुद्रः सरितां पतिः ।
समुद्रवचनाच्चैव नलं सेतुमकारयत् ॥
verses.hi: तब नदियों के स्वामी समुद्र ने स्वयं प्रकट होकर दर्शन दिए, और समुद्र के ही सुझाव से राम ने नल के द्वारा पुल बँधवाया।
verses.en: Ocean, lord of rivers, revealed himself, and at Ocean’s counsel Rāma had Nala build a bridge across the waters.

verses.sa:
तेन गत्वा पुरीं लङ्कां हत्वा रावणमाहवे ।
रामः सीतामनुप्राप्य परां व्रीडामुपागमत् ॥
verses.hi: उस सेतु से लंकापुरी में जाकर और युद्ध में रावण का वध करके, सीता को पुनः प्राप्त करने पर राम को लोकनिन्दा के भय से संकोच हुआ।
verses.en: Crossing by it to Laṅkā and slaying Rāvaṇa in battle, Rāma regained Sītā, yet felt deep distress over public reproach.

verses.sa:
तामुवाच ततो रामः परुषं जनसंसदि ।
अमृष्यमाणा सा सीता विवेश ज्वलनं सती ॥
verses.hi: तब राम ने लोगों की सभा में सीता से कठोर वचन कहे; उसे सहन न कर सकी साध्वी सीता प्रज्वलित अग्नि में प्रविष्ट हो गईं।
verses.en: He spoke harsh words to her in the assembly of all; unable to bear them, faithful Sītā entered the blazing fire.

verses.sa:
ततोऽग्निवचनात् सीतां ज्ञात्वा विगतकल्मषाम् ।
कर्मणा तेन महता त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ॥
verses.hi: तदनन्तर अग्निदेव के वचन से सीता को सर्वथा निष्कलंक जानकर राम के उस महान कर्म से चराचर तीनों लोक
verses.en: Then, assured by Agni’s word that Sītā was wholly pure, at that great deed the three worlds with all moving and unmoving beings,

verses.sa:
सदेवर्षिगणं तुष्टं राघवस्य महात्मनः ॥
बभौ रामः सम्प्रहृष्टः पूजितः सर्वदेवतैः ॥
verses.hi: तथा देवताओं और ऋषियों का समूह महात्मा राघव पर अत्यंत संतुष्ट हुआ, और सर्वदेवपूजित राम अत्यंत शोभित हुए।
verses.en: together with gods and sages, rejoiced in great-souled Rāghava; and Rāma shone with gladness, honored by all the celestials.

verses.sa:
अभ्यषिच्य च लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रं विभीषणम् ।
कृतकृत्यस्तदा रामो विज्वरः प्रमुमोद ह ॥
verses.hi: लंका में राक्षसराज विभीषण का राज्याभिषेक करके कृतकृत्य तथा संतापरहित हुए राम अत्यंत प्रसन्न हुए।
verses.en: Anointing Vibhīṣaṇa, best of rākṣasas, as king in Laṅkā, Rāma felt his task fulfilled, freed from sorrow and joyful.

verses.sa:
देवताभ्यो वरं प्राप्य समुत्थाप्य च वानरान् ।
अयोध्यां प्रस्थितो रामः पुष्पकेण सुहृद्वृतः ॥
verses.hi: देवताओं से वर प्राप्त कर और मृत वानरों को पुनः जीवित कराकर राम मित्रों सहित पुष्पक विमान से अयोध्या की ओर प्रस्थित हुए।
verses.en: Receiving a boon from the gods and reviving the fallen vānaras, Rāma set out for Ayodhyā aboard the Puṣpaka chariot surrounded by friends.

verses.sa:
भरद्वाजाश्रमं गत्वा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ।
भरतस्यान्तिके रामो हनूमन्तं व्यसर्जयत् ॥
verses.hi: भरद्वाज मुनि के आश्रम में पहुँचकर सत्यपराक्रमी राम ने भरत के पास हनुमान् को समाचार देने भेजा।
verses.en: Stopping at Bharadvāja’s hermitage, Rāma of true prowess sent Hanumān ahead to Bharata.

verses.sa:
पुनराख्यायिकां जल्पन् सुग्रीवसहितस्तदा ।
पुष्पकं तत् समारुह्य नन्दिग्रामं ययौ तदा ॥
verses.hi: तब सुग्रीव के साथ पुरानी कथाओं की चर्चा करते हुए वे पुष्पक विमान पर आरूढ़ होकर नन्दिग्राम पहुँचे।
verses.en: Then, conversing of past events with Sugrīva, he boarded the Puṣpaka chariot and journeyed to Nandigrāma.

verses.sa:
नन्दिग्रामे जटां हित्वा भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽनघः ।
रामः सीतामनुप्राप्य राज्यं पुनरवाप्तवान् ॥
verses.hi: नन्दिग्राम में जटा त्यागकर भाइयों सहित निष्पाप राम ने सीता को साथ लेकर अपना राज्य पुनः प्राप्त किया।
verses.en: At Nandigrāma, the sinless Rāma cut off his matted locks together with his brothers, and reunited with Sītā regained his kingdom.

verses.sa:
प्रहृष्टमुदितो लोकस्तुष्टः पुष्टः सुधार्मिकः ।
निरामयो ह्यरोगश्च दुर्भिक्षभयवर्जितः ॥
verses.hi: प्रजाजन अत्यंत हर्षित, संतुष्ट, पुष्ट और अत्यंत धार्मिक हो गए; सारा जगत रोग, शोक और अकाल के भय से रहित हो गया।
verses.en: The people shall be joyous, delighted, content, nourished, deeply righteous, healthy, free from disease, and free from fear of famine.

verses.sa:
न पुत्रमरणं केचित् द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुरुषाः क्वचित् ।
नार्यश्चाविधवा नित्यं भविष्यन्ति पतिव्रताः ॥
verses.hi: कहीं कोई पुरुष अपने पुत्र की मृत्यु नहीं देखेगा; सभी स्त्रियाँ सदा सधवा और पतिव्रता बनी रहेंगी।
verses.en: Nowhere shall parents witness the death of a child, and women shall ever remain faithful wives and never know widowhood.

verses.sa:
न चाग्निजं भयं किञ्चिन्नाप्सु मज्जन्ति जन्तवः ।
न वातजं भयं किञ्चित् नापि ज्वरकृतं तथा ॥
verses.hi: न अग्नि से कोई भय होगा, न प्राणी जल में डूबेंगे; न वायु का कोई प्रकोप होगा और न ज्वर आदि रोगों का भय रहेगा।
verses.en: There shall be no fear of fire, nor shall creatures drown in water; there shall be no peril from wind, nor affliction from fever.

verses.sa:
न चापि क्षुद्भयं तत्र न तस्करभयं तथा ।
नगराणि च राष्ट्राणि धनधान्ययुतानि च ॥
verses.hi: न वहाँ भूख का कष्ट होगा और न चोरों का भय रहेगा; सभी नगर और राष्ट्र धन-धान्य से परिपूर्ण रहेंगे।
verses.en: There shall be no fear of hunger or of thieves; cities and kingdoms shall overflow with wealth and grain.

verses.sa:
नित्यं प्रमुदिताः सर्वे यथा कृतयुगे तथा ।
अश्वमेधशतैरिष्ट्वा तथा बहुसुवर्णकैः ॥
verses.hi: सत्ययुग के समान सभी लोग नित्य आनंदित रहेंगे। सैकड़ों अश्वमेध यज्ञों और बहुसुवर्णक यज्ञों का अनुष्ठान करके,
verses.en: All shall live in constant joy as in the Kṛta Yuga. Performing a hundred horse sacrifices and many gold-rich rites,

verses.sa:
गवां कोट्ययुतं दत्त्वा विद्वद्भ्यो विधिपूर्वकम् ।
असंख्येयं धनं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यो महायशाः ॥
verses.hi: विद्वानों को विधिपूर्वक करोड़ों-अरबों गौएँ तथा ब्राह्मणों को असंख्य धन दान देकर महायशस्वी राघव
verses.en: bestowing ten million kine duly upon scholars and countless wealth upon brāhmaṇas, the illustrious Rāghava

verses.sa:
राजवंशान् शतगुणान् स्थापयिष्यति राघवः ।
चातुर्वर्ण्यं च लोकेऽस्मिन् स्वे स्वे धर्मे नियोक्ष्यति ॥
verses.hi: सौ गुना अधिक राजवंशों की स्थापना करेंगे और इस लोक में चारों वर्णों को अपने-अपने धर्म में नियुक्त करेंगे।
verses.en: shall establish royal dynasties a hundredfold and set all four orders of society firmly in their respective duties.

verses.sa:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च ।
रामो राज्यमुपासित्वा ब्रह्मलोकं प्रयास्यति ॥
verses.hi: ग्यारह सहस्र वर्ष तक राज्य का पालन करके राम ब्रह्मलोक को प्रस्थान करेंगे।
verses.en: Having ruled the kingdom for eleven thousand years, Rāma shall depart to the realm of Brahmā.

verses.sa:
इदं पवित्रं पापघ्नं पुण्यं वेदैश्च सम्मितम् ।
यः पठेद् रामचरितं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.hi: जो मनुष्य पवित्र, पापहारी, पुण्यदायक और वेदों के समान इस रामचरित का पाठ करता है, वह सब पापों से मुक्त हो जाता है।
verses.en: Whoever reads this sacred, sin-destroying, meritorious tale of Rāma, equal to the Vedas, is freed from all sin.

verses.sa:
एतदाख्यानमायुष्यं पठन् रामायणं नरः ।
सपुत्रपौत्रः सगणः प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ॥
verses.hi: आयु बढ़ाने वाले इस रामायण आख्यान को पढ़ने वाला मनुष्य पुत्र-पौत्रों और स्वजनों सहित मृत्यु के उपरांत स्वर्ग में सम्मानित होता है।
verses.en: Reading this life-lengthening Rāmāyaṇa, a person is honored in heaven after death along with sons, grandsons, and kinsmen.

verses.sa:
पठन् द्विजो वागृषभत्वमीयात् ।
त् क्षत्रियो भूमिपतित्वमीयात् ॥
वणिक् जनः पण्यफलत्वमीयात् ।
जनश्च शूद्रोऽपि महत्त्वमीयात् ॥
verses.hi: इसे पढ़कर ब्राह्मण वाक्-सिद्धि प्राप्त करता है, क्षत्रिय पृथ्वी का स्वामित्व पाता है, वैश्य व्यापार में उत्तम फल प्राप्त करता है और शूद्र भी महान प्रतिष्ठा को प्राप्त होता है।
verses.en: Reading it, a brāhmaṇa attains mastery of speech, a kṣatriya gains dominion over the earth, a vaiśya achieves prosperity in trade, and a śūdra too attains greatness.
